name: Translate
description: Translate web pages on this device, without sending page text anywhere

commands.name: translate page
commands.description: Translate the current web page on this device. Optionally name the language to translate into, such as de or fr; otherwise the system language is used.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to translate into, such as de, fr or ja.

commands.name: show original
commands.description: Put the current page's own text back after a translation.
